title: Weather
desc: The official weather app for mariowOS.
eula: This app is opensource and free to use, but it needs your location and internet connection to work. You can review the source code at https://github.com/mariowstech/weather, to analyze the code and see if it is safe to use. This app is not affiliated with any weather service provider.

title: Tiles Window Manager
desc:
The old Tiles version that was released in beta since beta 3. Improved, updated and adapted to be a secondary DE. 

⚠️ WARNING!!!
This isn't as stable as pre-installed new Tiles desktop environment. Some API calls are declined due to security issues. You can try to modify them to be adapted to the old DE but it's on you. I don't recommend doing so.
